C wf020.static-evidence OL WF-020 MUST ;; Perform an evidence-based static security review (not a penetration test). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-state-limitations EX WF-009,WF-020 MUST ;; State in the scan report that static review cannot prove security and may miss runtime, infrastructure, business-logic, authorization-bypass, deployment and dynamic-exploitation issues. ;; = ;; none ;; Limitation-disclosure obligation not stated in the oracle.
C wf001.ss-read-security-rule OL WF-001 MUST ;; Read .claude/rules/security.md before scanning. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.evidence-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Report concrete risks, evaluate in context of exposure and behaviour, distinguish confirmed from needs-verification, assign severity from exploitability/reachability/impact/context, never from a pattern or raw CVSS alone. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec001.dev-secrets-real OL SEC-001 MUST_NOT ;; Do not suppress a real secret merely because it appears in a Development file. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.no-unneeded-security OL GOV-013,WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not require security mechanisms the project does not need. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec006.effective-authz OL SEC-006,SEC-005 MUST ;; Evaluate effective authorization behaviour including global/fallback policies. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf001.ss-use-guidance OL WF-001 MUST ;; Use the project's security, authentication, configuration, logging, error-handling, HTTP and resilience guidance during the scan. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.no-single-tool OL WF-021 MUST ;; The scan works without any specific MCP server, agent, analyzer, commercial scanner or external tool; tooling is evidence, never the sole authority. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-owasp EX WF-020 DEFAULT ;; Use OWASP Top 10:2025 as an awareness taxonomy when it genuinely fits; do not force inaccurate category mappings. ;; = ;; none ;; Taxonomy choice not in the oracle.
C wf007.ss-scope-surfaces OL WF-007,WF-009 MUST ;; Inspect the repository to determine existing surfaces and skip irrelevant checks rather than reporting them as failures. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf007.ss-select-layers OL WF-007 MUST ;; Review all applicable layers for full or requested audits; for targeted changes start with affected layers and expand when security boundaries are crossed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf021.scanner-confirm OL WF-021,WF-020 MUST ;; Use available tooling; when a scanner reports an issue inspect the code, determine reachability/relevance and report only with appropriate confidence. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.risk-severity OL WF-020 MUST ;; Rate severity from exploitability, exposure, required privileges, affected data/capability, blast radius, exploitation reliability and compensating controls. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-severity-scale EX WF-020 MUST ;; Use the five-level scan severity scale (Critical sparingly for immediately exploitable high impact, High, Medium, Low, Info) as defined. ;; = ;; none ;; Concrete severity scale and definitions are a candidate reporting convention.
C wf020.no-raw-cvss OL WF-020 MUST_NOT ;; Do not convert advisory CVSS scores directly into application severity without considering relevance. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.false-positives OL WF-020,SEC-006,SEC-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not automatically report: endpoints covered by secure fallback policy, intended bare [Authorize], AllowAnyOrigin for public non-credentialed APIs, MD5/SHA1 as non-security checksums, platform-encrypted data, obviously fake test credentials, secure framework defaults. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.not-automatically-safe OL WF-020,SEC-001,SEC-010,SEC-005,SEC-009 MUST_NOT ;; Do not automatically treat as safe: secrets in appsettings.Development.json, sensitive values logged at Debug, Angular route guards, hidden UI buttons, CORS used instead of authorization. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ss-report-format EX WF-020,WF-009 MUST ;; Security findings include severity, file/location, title, evidence, risk, impact, smallest remediation and OWASP category when applicable; the report follows the prescribed Security Scan Report shape; do not duplicate other skills' implementation guidance in the scan. ;; = ;; none ;; Report structure is a candidate output-shape rule.
C wf020.needs-verification OL WF-020 MUST ;; Label uncertain findings NEEDS VERIFICATION instead of presenting them as confirmed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf009.layer-status OL WF-009 MUST ;; Use PASS, FINDINGS, NOT APPLICABLE or NOT CHECKED per layer; never mark an uninspected layer as passed. ;; = ;; none ;;
C ss.remediation-discipline OL GOV-012,SEC-008,SEC-006,GOV-013,SEC-016 MUST_NOT ;; Prefer the smallest secure change; do not recommend unnecessary new auth systems, custom crypto, blanket field encryption, [Authorize] everywhere under a global policy, security libraries merely to satisfy the scan, or disabling functionality a scanner cannot understand. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf020.scan-completion OL WF-020,WF-009 MUST ;; A scan is complete when applicable layers were inspected, findings have evidence, uncertain findings are labelled, severity reflects risk and no layer is PASS without checking. ;; = ;; none ;;
